finding.observed: The existing provenance coverage receipt validator enforced coverage-state rules but did not require unique target identifiers, unique claim transitions, or exact set equality between declared targets and transitions.
finding.inferred: A malformed receipt could therefore omit a declared target, introduce an undeclared target, or duplicate a transition while still passing the prior validator.
finding.proposed: Treat target-transition bijection and valid receipt timestamps as mandatory provenance invariants.
finding.superseded: A non-empty transition array is sufficient evidence that every declared continuity target was evaluated.
finding.unresolved: Immutable provenance for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remains unresolved because exhaustive ref and reachable-object coverage has not been obtained.

invariants_added: every declared target has exactly one transition
no transition may reference an undeclared target

limits: Tests were executed against byte-identical local source before connector commits.
No exhaustive all-ref inventory or complete reachable-object traversal was available in this run.
This evidence strengthens receipt integrity but does not resolve M-004, M-005, or M-006.
